NVDA.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigned over a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy; SEC now probing Nvidia's disclosures
NVDA.summary: Huang resigned on Nov 12 after a board investigation into his relationship with an executive suspected of spying for China; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the board has ruled out reinstating him. The SEC has opened a civil probe into Nvidia's disclosures, and sources say its accounting practices are a focus; California's attorney general has also subpoenaed the company over possible chip diversion to China and misleading investors. The DOJ is examining chip exports via Singapore, a shareholder class action is pending, and Huang is due before three House committees on Dec 1.
